notes.title: The Penguin Factory - Version 1.0.4 Released
notes.content:
A minor update, mostly to fix a few things:

Features

 Improved animations at higher and lower than expected frame rates.
 Improved some help text in the level editor.

Fixes

 Fixed issue where the mallet could miss some penguins when the game was in fast forward mode.
 Fixed bug where music would cut out for a frame or two when going from the title screen to the game and vice versa.
 Fixed bug where multiple turntable sound effects could play at once.
 Prevents level editor components being placed when a help screen is visible.
 Minor efficiency improvements.

notes.title: The Penguin Factory Update
notes.content:
Just a quick update to version 1.0.3 with the following improvements and fixes:

Improvements

When playing or modifying a level created via the Steam Workshop, returns to the level details rather than all the way back to the title screen when done.
Added the version number to the credits screen.

Fixes

Fixed placing level components in the level editor from being slightly off on non-widescreen displays.
Fixed dragging level components around in the level editor from jumping around the screen when using touchscreen.
Clicking cancel on the on-screen keyboard when setting a level name or description now reverts the text back to what it was before rather than clearing it.

notes.title: The Penguin Factory - Version 1.0.2 Available
notes.content:
Quick update with a few changes and fixes:

Changes

Added new in-game shortcut keys - "[" and "]" to rotate the camera and "R" to restart a level. These can be redefined.
The in-game workshop search screen now allows filtering on your Steam friends' levels.
The level description is now shown in the details of a user-generated content level when viewing it.

Fixes

Fixed issue with mallet accuracy if the frame rate was low.
Fixed issue where splitter arrows didn't always change direction when the game was in fast forward mode.

Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far. We'd love to see some more of your workshop levels!
